grid.description: Maps to the echart config grid property;

series.description:
Maps to the eChart config series property; contains the data that will
be charted.

missing.description: Indicates how much missing data there is for each of the sets of values in series.

singleValue.description:
If provided, this value is the one that is going to be displayed on the metric tile title and no additional processing will be done.
If not provided, the value will be calculated based on the chart configuration.
